description.value:
Frequency once per day

Once per day, you may do the spirit an unprompted kindness — an act it did not ask for and you gain nothing from — and immediately erase 1 point of Toll. The GM judges whether an act qualifies; an act performed in order to trigger this feat does not. The kindness costs whatever it costs in the fiction and nothing mechanically.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Immediately erase 1 point of Toll" needs Toll to have rule-element representation to decrement -- there is no counter to decrement in the first place, and the trigger ("an unprompted kindness, GM-judged authenticity") is also a pure narrative/GM-adjudicated trigger with zero stated numbers of its own attached to a real tracked value.
